title: Heatmap-driven eval escrow for canary and A/B pipelines
creator: Aisha Reynolds
description:
Purpose: build an eval escrow mechanism that gates canary and A/B traffic via a heatmap-driven scorecard. The escrow holds incremental traffic for a candidate model until per-prompt and per-cohort metrics pass configurable thresholds. This reduces noisy rollouts and enables automated rollback/quarantine for segment-specific regressions.

Background/context: we've had several incidents where overall aggregate eval signals were within tolerance but concentrated regressions in a small cohort caused customer-impacting outcomes. Current guardrails are aggregate scorecards and golden prompt counts; they lack cohort heatmaps, escrow plumbing, and a consistent hysteresis policy for auto-rollback. This ticket implements a new pattern: compute a prompt-by-cohort metric heatmap, derive dynamic escrow rules, and wire the rollout conductor to honor escrow and quarantine buckets.

High-level design decisions made so far:
- Use existing eval ingestion pipeline (ClickHouse materialized tables) for per-prompt-per-cohort metrics to avoid adding new write paths.
- Scorecard will emit three signals: coverage (fraction of golden prompts seen), dispersion (variance of delta vs baseline), and worst-N tail (median and 95th percentile deltas).
- Heatmap thresholds are cohort-aware: critical cohorts (enterprise customers, region-specific legal segments) use stricter limits.
- Escrow semantics: when a model is promoted to canary/AB, initial traffic is held in an "escrow" group for X minutes (configurable) while realtime probes feed the scorecard. If any cohort breaches thresholds, escrow is paused and that cohort's traffic is routed to fallback models and flagged for quarantine.
- Auto-rollback: hysteresis requires sustained breach for a configurable window (default 5m) before automatic rollback; immediate alerting to oncall is performed on first breach.

Acceptance criteria (must be all satisfied for done):
- Heatmap generator produces per-prompt-per-cohort delta matrix in ClickHouse with a documented schema.
- Escrow API and rollout-conductor integration exist: rollout-conductor can place traffic into escrow, check scorecard status via API, and promote/unpause or quarantine cohorts.
- Config YAML for canary/AB shows cohort thresholds and hysteresis options and is validated by unit tests.
- Demo run: deploy a test candidate against synthetic cohorts showing acceptance path and a quarantine path; include dashboard screenshots.
- Instrumentation/alerts: an SLO dashboard in Console with a heatmap panel and an alert rule for sustained cohort breaches.

Implementation tasks (high-level):
1) Data: add materialized view in ClickHouse for per-prompt-per-cohort metrics and exporter for the scorecard service.
2) Scorecard service: implement heatmap calculator, threshold engine, and a simple rule compiler that outputs escrow decisions.
3) Rollout conductor: add escrow lifecycle hooks (create_escrow, check_escrow, promote_escrow, quarantine_cohort, rollback_flow).
4) Config: YAML schema, validation, and UI knobs in Console for cohort thresholds.
5) Tests: unit tests for rule compiler, integration test that runs a simulated canary with golden prompt set, and end-to-end test exercising auto-rollback.
6) Observability: dashboards, traces, and add logs for escrow decisions and cohort quarantines.
7) Playbook: update runbook with steps for manual override and postmortem guidance for cohort quarantines.

Risks and mitigations:
- False positives from small-sample cohorts: mitigate via minimum-sample gating and Bayesian shrinkage in score calculations.
- Latency impact on rollouts: escrow checks are async; we will sample probes at t=0, t=30s, t=2m to avoid blocking steady-state traffic.
- Complexity for console users: provide sane defaults and a one-click "safety tether" profile.

Related artifacts and links:
- Confluence design doc: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/INFRA/pages/heatmap-escrow-design (draft)
- Prototype PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/rollout-conductor/pull/812 (WIP)
- Dashboard mockups: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/heatmap-escrow-mockups
- Golden prompt set definition: gs://redwood-evals/golden_sets/cohorted_v1.json

Test plan summary:
- Unit: rule compiler edge cases, threshold parsing, hysteresis timer.
- Integration: local ClickHouse + scorecard service + conductor runbook verifying promote/quarantine flows against produced heatmaps.
- E2E: deploy to staging with synthetic cohorts, intentionally inject a regression for one cohort and verify that only that cohort is quarantined and auto-rollback triggers after hysteresis.
